I’m in for 12 tons this month, with no extra catch. I also support 6 each if next month’s stock is 80, and returning to 12 each when it’s 100. John’s 10.8-ton long-run average gives us a good reason to try this stock-dependent plan rather than focus only on this month’s bonus.

Let’s make those quotas conditional on everyone agreeing. If the revealed catches leave us with a different stock, we should negotiate fresh whole-ton limits before fishing again—not assume the same quota still works. Any overcatch should prompt a discussion and a revised agreement, not a race to empty the lake.

Kate, are you comfortable joining this plan?
